digest.component_or_area: Claude Code MCP configuration, Serena symbol tools
propositions: Serena symbol tool schemas are deferred by default, requiring an extra ToolSearch round-trip before use, creating friction asymmetry against cheaper tools like grep
The deferral control ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH is all-or-nothing and global—no per-tool or per-server setting exists—making it impossible to defer only non-Serena tools as originally planned

A tracked .claude/settings.json with ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH set to false loads all MCP tool schemas at session start, eliminating discovery-step friction at a measured cost of 25k–64k context tokens depending on connected servers
The original AC assumed per-tool and per-server deferral controls that do not exist in Claude Code's agent SDK, and must be corrected to reflect the actual global all-or-nothing lever

Measurement and cost justification are required before choosing the setting value, and the tradeoff is large enough (2.7x cost on a typical host) that operator-side MCP surface trimming is a viable alternative to the blanket setting
